meta.description: Global Error Trigger workflow (n8n setting: errorWorkflow). Fires when ANY workflow that references it throws an unhandled error. It is the dead-letter + alerting seam: it logs structured detail and notifies the team so nothing fails silently. The main pipeline already downgrades expected failures to 'partial'/'failed' results; this catches the unexpected.

parameters.subject: =[Southpage Automation] Unhandled error in {{ $json.workflow }}

nodes.name: Alert Team
nodes.notes: Uses SMTP credentials configured in n8n. Swap for Slack/Twilio by replacing this node — the trigger and formatter are unchanged.
